- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-16-a-location-keeps-working-without-internet-and-only-the-card-stops.md]] — Val reverses the engineering position on offline behaviour: **a location keeps working with no internet** — wallets are created locally and players go on playing; only card issuance and redemption stop, **lease expiry is the only thing that blocks a machine**, boot no longer requires internet, and a device may run 24 hours without the server; the product-owner principle behind it — "вы не можете позволить, чтобы лакейша не работал"; the 24-hour figure is a **working number, not settled** — Val himself said it might be too long while Klimovich argued for no limit at all and Pavel for until-the-lease-expires; status active (2 sources, updated 2026-09-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-16-anything-that-depends-on-the-cloud-leaves-mvp1.md]] — **"Надо быть честной с самим собой… Всё, что мы не можем сделать 1 октября, уберите"** — anything depending on the cloud comes out of MVP 1: capability 116 gutted and requirements 1379/1431/1444/1450/1483/1485 pushed to MVP 2, with Val's blunter version, "самим себе врать нельзя"; **the MVP 2 cloud capability exists but its number (177) is PROVISIONAL** — the team hung a requirement on 177 because it was the highest-numbered capability, while Klimovich recognised 177 as the *balance* one, so the identification is flagged Tier A rather than asserted; status active (5 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-16-fifteen-flex-ports-in-mvp1-and-the-system-designed-for-ninety-nine.md]] — requirement 1432 fixes **15 Flex-Ports per location for MVP 1 while the system is designed for 99** ("система нужен дизайн на 99" / "Ну давайте поправим на 15"), against a Georgia reality of "одна локация, максимум 9 машин игровых"; what happens **above** the limit is deliberately left open for load testing rather than guessed; status active (3 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-16-the-mvp1-timing-numbers-two-hundred-milliseconds-and-thirty-seconds.md]] — the three MVP 1 timing numbers settled: **200 ms between screens under load** (requirement 1435, "200 миллисекунд это стандарт ну мировой"), **30 s to wait for an activation answer** (1437/1438), and the **30 s FlexPort collect timeout made universal rather than per-location** (1469) — all explicitly provisional, "давайте 30 секунд опытным путём, придём к другой возможно цифре"; a silent InComm leaves a pending transaction; status active (3 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-16-incomm-returns-no-daily-cap-error-so-the-call-comes-to-jvl-first.md]] — Dzmitry Chudzinau **read the InComm API documentation live on the call** and found there is no daily-cap error at all ("ти дели кап нет. Соответственно и ошибок никаких не будет"), so requirement 1533 is deleted and a capped location must **call JVL first** to have the cap inferred from the logs; notable as a rare case of an external platform's limits being checked against its own docs mid-meeting rather than assumed; status active (2 sources, updated 2026-09-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-16-there-is-no-cash-on-flexpay-in-any-form.md]] — **"нету никакого кэша на flixpay… Ни в каком виде"** — the cash-return end state comes out of card issuance (requirement 1382) and the cash-return option out of Flex IQ (1441); FlexPay dispenser-jam and trash-box cases are pushed to MVP 2; status active (2 sources, updated 2026-09-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-16-a-kiosk-is-de-enrolled-from-a-location-never-from-the-cloud-database.md]] — requirement 1378: a registered kiosk is **de-enrolled from a location but never deleted from the cloud database** — it becomes online or warehouse status and nothing is ever removed ("зарегистрировано навсегда… ничего не удаляется"); status active (2 sources, updated 2026-09-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-16-a-self-service-ticket-is-collected-at-the-service-kiosk-with-a-four-digit-pin.md]] — MVP 2 direction for the self-service kiosk: **nothing prints there**; the player carries a **four-digit one-time redemption PIN** to the service kiosk instead; **QR was rejected on access grounds, not technical ones** — Klimovich refused to invent a take-up percentage and argued plainly that "у большого пользователя нету даже смартфонов"; status active (2 sources, updated 2026-09-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-17-jvl-supports-multiple-incomm-products-not-a-fixed-pair.md]] — **(Sept-17 2026 — design stands; the MVP 1 SCOPE half was contested on Sept 18 and is SETTLED by owner ruling 2026-09-20)** InComm launched SkillPay the previous day, and rather than hard-code a second card JVL generalises: the location's single UPC field becomes a **collection of products on the payment hub**, each with its own UPC, fees and limits, the UPC read from the card's own barcode, and the location manager declining anything unavailable — Klimovich's own mid-sentence correction is the decision ("2 продуктов нет, не 2. Мы делаем поддержку мультипродуктов"); fees differ ($2 for the incumbent card against **$3 for SkillPay, which has cash access**), load caps coincide at 5 and 1,000 but are **explicitly not guaranteed**; **on Sept 18 the delivery was cut back to a single product** — Klimovich "almost finally" that two products will not be built for MVP 1 — **against Val's own written chat instruction that 178 must be in MVP 1**, and the call ended unreconciled; **the owner ruled on 2026-09-20 that "Klimovich is correct"** — two-product support is NOT in MVP 1 and Val's instruction is withdrawn by him, while the payment-hub design itself is untouched; **which single product MVP 1 ships was NOT separately ruled** (Klimovich's stated fallback was SkillPay alone) and is carried as an open question rather than inferred; the capability number **178** is established (10 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-17-the-device-does-the-routers-job-firewall-nat-and-wan-lan-profiles-stay-in-mvp1.md]] — requirement **1556**: with no router in front of an LTE-modem device, and CloudFront hiding JVL's dynamic cloud addresses so the SIM carrier cannot fence what the device may reach ("симки должны видеть весь интернет по факту"), firewall, NAT and WAN/LAN profiles **stay in MVP 1** — and the thing that settled it was **the traffic bill, not a threat model**: bots pinging an internet-reachable device cost money because "у нас там Андрей не анлим на этих сим картах… Мы платим за мегабайты", after which "Всё всё мы решили, оставляем в VP один"; **the entire CloudFront explanation — the technical ground for the whole ruling — is absent from the derived notes**; status active (4 sources, updated 2026-10-05)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-17-bosiks-network-list-splits-between-mvp1-and-mvp2.md]] — an item-by-item split of the DevOps network list across capabilities 144 and 91 and requirements 1410/1411/1413/1418/1421/1431/1030, with **remote FlexPort firmware update leaving MVP 1**; the page records what the notes flatten — capability 144's own fix version is **left unclear** because after thinning Bosik said "144 окей… это идёт в MVP один" and Klimovich answered only "Угу", and requirement 1410 is taken for the **portal dashboard** rather than the device, a distinction the notes conflate; requirement **1421** is explained for the first time (replacing an IQ gateway loses every issued-but-unredeemed ticket — "это в mv 2 уезжает. Мы понимаем эти риски"); status active (3 sources, updated 2026-09-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-17-signal-quality-in-mvp1-means-remote-visibility-not-a-screen.md]] — signal quality in MVP 1 means **remote visibility, not a bar graphic**: bars lie next to a jammer, so decibels and SNR go into the logs as periodic metrics, buffered to file while offline and flushed on reconnect, with Grafana treated as a **separate second task** rather than part of the requirement; status active (9 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-17-lte-is-the-default-route-and-the-manual-override-stays.md]] — requirement 1405: **LTE is the default route** with metrics 0/10/20 across LTE, LAN and Wi-Fi, and **the manual override stays** for the concrete reason that some locations are basements with no LTE at all; automatic priority selection waits for Wi-Fi in MVP 2; status active (3 sources, updated 2026-10-05)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-17-the-operations-portal-not-the-cloud.md]] — the back-office stops being called "the cloud" — and is **not** a CRM — for an unusually modern reason: the word misleads **Bosik's Claude** when it reads the requirements; the replacement name is **the derived notes' gloss of a garble and is flagged as such rather than asserted**; status active (2 sources, updated 2026-09-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-18-no-rollback-to-a-previous-build-and-the-team-rolls-forward-only.md]] — requirement **1367** under capability **122** (self-corrected on air from 1349) comes out of MVP 1: **there is no rolling back to a previous build**, because the database schema moves with the code — "Структура база данных во времени меняется" — so an old build meets a structure it does not match, the worked example being the wallet table disappearing when the balance moves to the cloud; Andrey Bosik turns it into standing policy — "надо придерживаться всегда форвард… нашли баг, выпустили следующую версию, накатили, обновили всё" — and Val kills the requirement from the chat; status active (2 sources, updated 2026-09-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-18-mvp1-supports-dual-sas-only-and-locations-are-chosen-to-match.md]] — **MVP 1 supports dual SAS only** and the pilot **locations are chosen to match** ("выбирать локации… полностью эквиппед с SAS машинами"), with the bill-acceptor/counter-emulation MudaGoose route deferred; the argument that carried it is **test cost**, not capability — Pavel Frolov: "поддерживать оба это почти икс 2 тестирования"; **Klimovich flags the market question as still unresolved**, and this is added as a further dated datum to the standing single-SAS contradiction — which is **widened, not narrowed**; status active (3 sources, updated 2026-10-05)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-18-nothing-is-closed-until-the-conflict-findings-are-worked-back-in.md]] — Dzmitry Chudzinau ran a **Claude conflict sweep across the entire MVP 1 requirement set** and it found real contradictions — a surviving PIN requirement against the dropped PIN among them — so **nothing may be marked complete** until the findings are worked back in: a feature already delivered may no longer cover its capability once a late requirement lands on it ("Пока ничего не закрывается"); **no test and no date exist for when the freeze lifts**, which is recorded as an open question rather than smoothed over; status active (2 sources, updated 2026-09-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-18-the-mvp1-capability-list-is-walked-item-by-item-and-every-capability-gets-an-owner.md]] — the full pre-gate sweep, walked twice at Val's instruction: **every capability gets an owner and a status** — 178 held, **144 cloned** (trimmed original stays MVP 1, clone goes MVP 2, which finally answers its fix-version question), FlexPay capabilities 117/79/80/116/156 pushed out to MVP 2 under Biratka, 151/163/174/175/176/148/149/150 to Chudinov, 180 taken off a developer — plus two process rules: **requirements do not hang on developers**, and Pavel's test-executions amendment; Klimovich binds himself to a scope freeze, "больше ничего никуда долетать нельзя. Это в том числе сам себе говорю"; status active (9 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-17-hard-geometry-from-the-scene-files-and-a-vertical-skeleton-per-game-format.md]] — Val re-specifies the whole art→code pipeline on a single principle: **the artist's intent is not the input — the hard geometry already written in the scene files is**, read out with JVL's existing parsers ("у нас в рамках инструментов написаны парсеры, которые вот эту самую существующую [геометрию] разбирают"); from that, **a fixed vertical skeleton per game format** with progressive, dashboard and credits pinned and only screen-size parameters recomputed; and his answer to Igor Metelski's blocking question — **the reference layout for a conversion is another vertical game JVL already has** ("Мы… берем за эталон раскладку на другую вертикальную игру"); Igor commits to skeletons for about **six horizontal games** (3×3, 3×5, 4×5) by Friday or Monday; **Pavel Frolov and Irina Shishko's pay-table objection is left unresolved, not talked down** — "оно необязательно от игры к игре повторяется… это мы в скелет никак не сможем"; status active (4 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-17-kleimenychev-is-hired-from-monday-onto-texas-and-class-a-in-full-secrecy.md]] — **Sergey Kleimenychev is hired from Monday onto Texas and Class A, "в полном в полном секрете"**, with Val directing it himself ("А командовать парадом буду я") and refusing the candidate's single question — whether he may consult Lena — outright ("Что абсолютно нет"); the risk posture is agreed in Val's own terms ("100% только таксы и смерть") against Pavel's "we don't know if the result will be 100%, but the experiment can be run"; **the Sept-21 date is DERIVED, not spoken** (the source says only "с понедельника") and **which Class A market is never stated**, so neither is asserted; **§15.8 — most of this seven-minute call was NOT ingested**: nine classes of personal-assessment material about three named people were deliberately withheld, and boxed exclusion notes sit on this page and on every person page it touches; **no compensation of any kind exists in the source** — there was nothing of that class to withhold; status active (2 sources, updated 2026-09-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-17-no-more-games-on-rage-and-texas-is-built-on-nova.md]] — **"не делать никаких игр в речь… Я предлагаю сразу переключиться на нового и Техас сделать на ново"** — the **first platform choice for Texas anywhere in the corpus**, prompted by Pavel Frolov pointing out that the experiment then running would produce RAGE output needing a second conversion into NOVA; recorded with the thing a summary would lose — **nobody answered for about nine seconds**, and Val closed it himself with "Я понял, что вы согласны" and "время на полемику нету"; the page carries an explicit five-point list of what this ruling does **NOT** do — it gives RAGE **no sunset date**, leaves **NOVA→GLI unscheduled**, does not touch the Sept-14 finding that RAGE is faster today or that NOVA cannot yet run several games in one shell, and does not create the Sept-3 integration repository — so a seven-minute direction statement cannot later be mistaken for a schedule; status active (5 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-17-planning-comes-off-pavel-and-goes-to-an-application-administrator.md]] — **"Паша с вас нужно снять… Планирование"**: plan *administration* moves off Pavel Frolov to a proposed **"application administrator"** — a role name produced by Irina Shishko's own question — with **Dmitri Kovalchuk named but NOT yet asked** ("Както нужно уговорить. Это вам."); the method is that Irina and Pavel sit with him, **record** the planning conversation, and he administers and reports back on a cadence; Val's stated gains are extra hands, a good administrator, "полный трансперация", and Pavel freed to come to Atlanta; **the cadence is garbled in the source ("каждые 14:00") and is left unrecovered rather than guessed** — the derived notes flagged the same gap; status active (15 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-17-a-metal-mesh-on-standoffs-covers-the-flexpay-slim-service-bay-and-legs-replace-the-string.md]] — Val inspects the **first built FlexPay Slim** himself and overrules Genadi Peari's "it is already a locked service compartment" argument: a **flat metal mesh on standoffs** covers the service bay — explicitly **not** a box and not a plate, and cheap enough that it "стоила нам буквально копейки" — and **two damped legs near the hinge replace the taut string** stopper, with Genadi's gas-strut point removing the travel stoppers; Val asks for an "**air шок**" in his own words (the derived notes flatten this into Genadi's later "gas"); he **declines to specify** whether the lid self-opens or merely damps — "Я оставляю это для вас, как вы хотите" — and Genadi corrects him that the front-to-back rewiring is **not** yet done; §15.8 — this is a critique of a named person's work and **only the engineering faults are recorded**, never a judgement of the person; status active (3 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-17-import-duty-gets-its-own-tax-category-in-business-central.md]] — the FlexPort board costs **$60 on order against the $46 it should be as a component** ("не не в $46, как должно быть, он нам будет обходиться в $60 изза этих таксов"), so the **BOM keeps the component price and a new import-duties tax category in Business Central carries the rest** — the first Business Central field request in the corpus to originate from hardware, and the first time import duty appears as a **per-part costing gap on a named component** rather than a general tariff topic; **no owner is named** for creating it; also records Val's markup on Genadi's hardware quotes, stated twice as "Я добавляю 30%" with a truer "около 35%" that **was not agreed**; open — what composes the $46→$60 gap and at what rate; status active (2 sources, updated 2026-09-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-16-lucky-coin-declines-exclusivity-and-opens-a-kiosk-pilot.md]] — Kyle Shepherd phones Val directly to decline **exclusivity and only exclusivity** — "I just don't know that I want to put myself in a box like that. As fast as the technology is changing in this state" — while offering **more JVL machines on the route plus a kiosk trial in "a location or two"**; Val apologises for the pressure and parks the pursuit outright: "I'm not gonna pursue this business. I'm gonna leave it in your court"; the answer came from a consultation circle ("Curtis and Barry and those guys") and one day later than promised, with Kyle noting "I probably would have given you this answer when we met last week"; open — whether the Sept-9 bundle survives without exclusivity, and what the kiosk pilot actually is; status active (4 sources, updated 2026-09-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-16-jvl-offers-arc-new-class-a-cabinets-at-2500-plus-20-percent.md]] — JVL offers ARC **brand-new complete Class A cabinets at $2,500 plus 20%**, taking possession of and scrapping ARC's own — **not accepted** ("Let me just think on that" / "Send me a message"); the page carries ARC's actual **Primero terms** ($1,000 software plus 10% on its own cabinet, 20% on Primero's, with up-front treatment uncertain in Sloan's own words) and the flat ruling that **ARC has ordered nothing** — Val's own 2026-09-16 correction, "I agree with your record, however, I played it to my advantage", keeps any ARC Class A order out of the forecast; Val's "Thirty bucks. Ten percent is three dollars" is recorded as **his assumption**, against Sloan's "Right now, I can't say it's a lot"; status active (2 sources, updated 2026-09-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-16-do-not-discount-hold-price-extend-terms-add-value.md]] — **do not discount into the Georgia market — hold the price, extend the terms, and add value instead**, ruled by Val at length and **against a direct objection from JVL's games lead in the same conversation** (who argued from a seven-machine location that "having an economical offering from JVL might make a lot of sense" and that "I'm not convinced that somebody's going to pull out an IGT name and put a JVL name in its place"); Val's counter-argument in five moves — **nobody has to displace anybody** ("still there are an average six machines in the location"); **what sells here is a new shape, not a better game**, because the buyers are "a tightly knit community… who are extremely gossipy, and they want to have every new toy in the market" while "game design… is an extremely marginal business"; **therefore price is not the lever** ("whether I sell it a discount or at a high price, people need to have it. I may as well sell it a high price"); **terms are**, because "every decision that an operator makes is a cash flow decision. It's not a price decision… So I'd rather extend my terms than cut down the price"; and **if a discount becomes unavoidable, discount from a high price or add a toy** (a POS, a kiosk, a store-surveillance package) rather than cutting the number; splits by category — **Class B expensive and looking expensive, Class A mass market where "we're fighting… literally for every ten dollars"**; status active (2 sources, updated 2026-09-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-17-jvl-ships-to-effingham-because-jj-evaluates-everything-there.md]] — **J&J evaluates everything in Effingham, Illinois, for every state it operates in** ("That was all evaluation for Nebraska or anywhere else that matters done here in Effingham"), so Val commits to ship games plus transactional equipment there, staff the install, and present in person — the route into Nebraska running through Illinois rather than Nebraska; status active (2 sources, updated 2026-09-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-17-halcyon-takes-one-machine-plus-the-free-transactional-package-first-week-of-november.md]] — Halcyon takes **one machine plus the free location-wide transactional package at $90/month per location, first week of November**, with JVL going into new locations plus a couple of high-volume ones while Axcess keeps the rest; **the $90 is stated per LOCATION three times at the door and confirmed back by Yash** — recorded as a dated data point on the standing per-location-vs-per-machine question, **not** as its resolution; status active (4 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-11-acceptance-criteria-live-in-the-regulations-not-the-capabilities.md]] — (Sept-11 2026, active) Irina Shishko's ruling that dissolves Dmitri Chudinov's objection: acceptance criteria live in the regulations, not the capabilities — "a capability is just a general description" — so duplicate per-product capabilities merge and are tagged by Component; aka three identical Wi-Fi capabilities (2 sources, updated 2026-09-11)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-11-accepted-means-reviewed-taken-into-work-is-the-move-to-to-do.md]] — (Sept-11 2026, active) Val redefines a misleading Jira status: **Accepted means reviewed**, and taken-into-work is the move to To Do; Dmitri Kovalchuk to automate capability status from feature status; aka "the green status in the middle misleads" (12 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-11-the-game-change-question-goes-to-gli-as-a-paid-consultation.md]] — (Sept-11 2026, active) what counts as a "game change" for regulatory purposes goes to **GLI as a paid consultation** — a deep-knowledge participant required and Val in the room, targeted for the week of Sept 14. **This is advisory, not a submission: NOVA → GLI remains unscheduled**; aka take it to the lab and pay for it (2 sources, updated 2026-09-11)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-10-diamond-buys-two-machines-instead-of-trading-the-fleet.md]] — (Sept-10 2026, active) Sean Fellows refuses the 74-machine fleet trade and commits instead to **two vertical machines in two different types of location**, around Oct 1 — "don't do ten, do two"; aka "I'm not going to upgrade 74 games" (2 sources, updated 2026-09-10)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-10-diamond-will-not-guarantee-card-clearance-debt.md]] — (Sept-10 2026, active) the **second master licensee** to refuse the broker backstop — "I'm not going to be a reseller… even with InComm we didn't want to get in the middle of it" — conceding only a call-first arrangement; the weekend-risk arithmetic is on the page; aka arms-length relationship, seventy-two hours (4 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-10-diamond-field-auditor-captures-jvl-settings-data.md]] — (Sept-10 2026, active) the **first operator to agree to collect field data for JVL for free** — its field auditor captures JVL settings data by QR code every two weeks, against Val's "we're operating blind"; aka field auditor, QR code every two weeks (3 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-10-the-lottery-tells-jvl-class-a-manufacturing-is-lawful-today.md]] — (Sept-10 2026, active) stated by the regulator in its own hearing room: Class A manufacturing is lawful today. Read alongside the same meeting's finding that there is **no Class A rulebook and no certification path**; aka Class A is lawful today (2 sources, updated 2026-09-10)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-10-no-class-a-build-until-the-january-legislature-is-heard.md]] — (Sept-10 2026, active — **titular claim STRAINED, not superseded**) Val will build no Class A product until the January legislature is heard: "I doubt very much that I can do anything until January." **One day later he chose the platform, set a Feb-1 goal and started three work streams** — the tension is recorded as an `## Open contradictions` entry on both pages with two readings offered and neither chosen, rather than silently resolved. Also sits against his own Aug-31 commitment to ARC of a Class A deal "within three months… January"; aka wait for January (4 sources, updated 2026-09-11)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-10-the-transactional-equipment-demonstration-goes-to-intralot.md]] — (Sept-10 2026, active) the transactional-equipment demonstration is routed to Intralot, which runs the Georgia central system and the Lottery's prototype lab; aka demonstration to Intralot (3 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-10-requirements-come-first-and-the-recycler-is-out-of-both-mvps.md]] — (Sept-10 2026, active) Pavel Frolov corrects the process order — requirements are step 2, the MVP split step 3 — and rules the **Flex-Recycler out of both MVPs**; MVP 1 targets Oct 1 and MVP 2 Nov 1, with Nov 1 liable to become Oct 21 for the Georgia expo; aka recycler out of both MVPs (8 sources, updated 2026-10-05)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-10-per-product-components-and-mvp-fix-versions-on-the-capability-project.md]] — (Sept-10 2026, active) per-product Jira components — FlexPay, Flex-IQ, FlexPort, Terminal Hub — with cloud deliberately not split out; the capability hangs on the product project, and MVPs become fix versions. The components do not yet exist and Dmitri Kovalchuk must create them; aka per-product components, MVP fix versions (4 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-10-capability-review-feedback-goes-into-the-meeting-chat.md]] — (Sept-10 2026, active) what a capability review must produce, and where disagreement gets logged — into the meeting chat rather than lost in the room; aka capability review feedback (3 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-09-val-discloses-the-incomm-displacement-intent-to-arcs-ceo.md]] — (Sept-9 2026, active) **the first time in the corpus** that JVL's intent to replace InComm on the back end is stated to anyone outside JVL — said to ARC's CEO with **no confidentiality agreement** ("we don't have a confidentiality agreement, but you're a senior executive, so I can trust you") and deliberately withheld from ARC's COO, who is JVL's actual working relationship there: "By the way, George does not know about our intent to replace income." Recorded as a standing exposure, not resolved; aka replace InComm on the back end (2 sources, updated 2026-09-09)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-09-arc-account-exclusivity-sought-and-not-obtained.md]] — (Sept-9 2026, active) **titled to the corrected outcome per §3**: the bundle was put to ARC's CEO and the account-level ask was made and **refused** — "I don't think you can buy my entire business" — and Val himself corrected on 2026-09-10 that the "verbal handshake from a CEO" was rhetoric, so no `active` headline asserts a deal that does not exist; aka ARC exclusivity (7 sources, updated 2026-09-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-09-sebastian-replaces-felipe-on-the-georgia-field-assignment.md]] — (Sept-9 2026, active) Sebastian replaces Felipe Miranda Giorgi on the Georgia field assignment and is needed on the ground earlier than planned — "Felipe cannot do that… the end of September is not workable for me". Who and what and the reason as stated only; **no compensation appears in either source and none is recorded** (§15.8); aka assign it to Sebastian (3 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-09-rao-takes-the-bundle-with-jvl-exclusive-in-the-location.md]] — (Sept-9 2026, active) the first live application of the exclusivity ruling: a $15,750 fifteen-game machine with **all** transactional kit free (~$15k of it) against JVL exclusivity in the location, a three-year location contract, and two years of undivided attention — the distributor says "I'm in", while noting the operator will not sign but the location may; aka "I'm in", buying the market (2 sources, updated 2026-09-09)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-09-jvl-supports-both-dual-sas-and-single-sas-and-not-mudagoose.md]] — (Sept-9 2026, active) decided on the spot in a sales room on the distributor's insistence — "you just made up our decision. We're going with both, but we're definitely not going with MudaGoose." Carries the Sept-7/Sept-8 collision as an **open contradiction** rather than resolving it, because the Sept-7 engineering ruling to drop the old-machine segment is not withdrawn by any source; aka we're going with both (7 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-09-val-asks-lucky-coin-for-its-entire-business.md]] — **(Sept-9 2026 — SUPERSEDED, exclusivity DECLINED Sept 16 2026)** an **account-level** exclusivity ask a week after the Sept-2 bundle: one machine per location at $15,750, five ports plus an IQ plus a Pay unit, a free FlexPay ($7,950) per location and free kiosk replacement — in exchange for the whole account; answer was due Tuesday Sept 15 and came one day late, on the 16th, as a **no to exclusivity and only to exclusivity** (Kyle Shepherd: "I just don't know that I want to put myself in a box like that. As fast as the technology is changing in this state") — see [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-16-lucky-coin-declines-exclusivity-and-opens-a-kiosk-pilot.md]]; **§3 retitle applied** so the headline no longer asserts a live ask, and the two conditional bundle commitments are left OPEN rather than withdrawn because acceptance never came; aka "pitchforks" (6 sources, updated 2026-09-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-09-flex-port-readiness-slips-to-september-25-and-stays-the-bottleneck.md]] — (Sept-9 2026, active) Pavel Frolov states Flex-Port readiness plainly: not Sept 11, probably not Sept 18, **best case Sept 25** — and it remains the bottleneck because FlexPay functionality cannot be verified until Flex-Port functionality exists. He takes SAS himself, which discharges the Sept-7 "settle who owns Flex-Port" question. Recorded as an estimate **beside** the standing Oct-1 plan of record, not replacing it (§11: a slip is not a decision change); aka Flex-Port best case September 25 (2 sources, updated 2026-09-09)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-09-first-transactional-installation-planned-for-october-1.md]] — **SUPERSEDED Sept-28 2026** — the first transactional installation was planned for October 1 (Sept-9); on Sept-28 October 15 became the working MVP 1 date; the FlexPay self-service configuration named here was already replaced by Flex IQ on Sept-11; office-rehearsal, LTE-modem and RK3568 content kept as history (11 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-09-one-transactional-unit-per-location-until-the-wi-fi-iteration.md]] — (Sept-9 2026, active) one transactional unit per location — FlexPay **or** Flex-IQ, never both — until iteration 2 brings Wi-Fi; aka one unit per location — Sept-30 2026 retitle: multiple units per location moved to a probable MVP 3, Wi-Fi stays MVP 2 (status active) (8 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-09-wi-fi-is-second-in-urgency-and-october-november-run-wires.md]] — (Sept-9 2026, active) Wi-Fi is explicitly the piece to sacrifice — "второй срочность", the thing "чем можно сейчас пожертвовать" — so October and November run wires, one per device, installed by junior electrical tradesmen, and Wi-Fi is not mentioned to customers; aka Wi-Fi second in urgency (4 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-09-the-ramp-counts-units-not-locations.md]] — (Sept-9 2026, active) the October–December ramp is counted in **units, not locations**. Both figure sets are recorded side by side as spoken to two different audiences the same morning — 1/10/200/500 installations (Russian call) against 100/500/1000 units (English session) — with Val's commercial-window rationale; aka the ramp counts units (4 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-09-planning-handed-to-bosik-and-kovalchuk-with-daily-recorded-sessions.md]] — (Sept-9 2026, active) Pavel Frolov stops planning by hand: planning passes to Andrey Bosik and Dmitri Kovalchuk, run as daily recorded sessions at 75–80%-good-enough, with Val on the invite but not attending; aka daily recorded planning sessions (3 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-09-negative-cases-first-and-flex-ports-tested-in-borrowed-non-jvl-machines.md]] — (Sept-9 2026, active) testing starts Sept 15 with **negative cases first** (door-open before anything else), and Flex-Ports are tested inside borrowed, fake-commissioned Aristocrat and Light & Wonder machines rather than JVL's own; two separate Jira items, plus router rules; aka negative cases first, borrowed machines (21 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-09-three-more-flex-port-features-onto-capability-165.md]] — (Sept-9 2026, active) three more Flex-Port features go onto **capability 165** — optional PIN, SAS machine flags, remote log retrieval — while wallet transfer is split into its own capability and a FPORT Jira project is split out of FP; aka capability 165 (2 sources, updated 2026-09-09)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-09-the-mould-without-the-screen-comes-first-and-the-printer-has-a-fallback.md]] — (Sept-9 2026, active) Genadi Peari's priority order: the mould **without** the screen comes first; the stock position is recorded, and the printer risk carries a named fallback; aka mould without the screen (2 sources, updated 2026-09-09)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-08-val-approaches-david-sloan-directly-with-the-bundle-offer.md]] — (Sept-8 2026, active) Zazanis makes the introduction and steps out of the middle, so Val takes the bundle offer straight to ARC's CEO David Sloan — "he's expecting you", "nothing to lose". The separate Aug-31 commitment to route the *kiosk board-swap* proposal through Sloan is **NOT** discharged by this: the route opened, but the board swap is never mentioned in either Sept-8 source; aka Zazanis steps aside (5 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-08-the-bundle-put-to-dixie-with-installation-explicitly-excluded.md]] — (Sept-8 2026, active) the bundle as put to Dixie: one machine plus five free ports plus a free counter unit, at $90 per **location** per month — with installation dangled at roughly $70,000 across the estate ($150/hour, two technicians, ~$1,000 a location, 60–70 locations) and then explicitly withdrawn: "I didn't say anything about installation… I didn't promise anything"; aka "it's unbearable", ninety bucks per location (3 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-08-first-nation-pricing-offered-to-salims-buying-group.md]] — (Sept-8 2026, active) offer Salim Khambawala's GAMOA buying group **First Nation pricing** — the same price as everyone else, with a guarantee nobody is ever quoted cheaper — on the 2015 Lee Hunter / IGT precedent; aka First Nation pricing, "never cheaper than to us" (3 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-07-flex-iq-cannibalises-mudagoose-no-parallel-operation.md]] — (Sept-7 2026, active) Val reverses his own "they run in parallel" position on **business** grounds, not technical ones — Flex-IQ cannibalises MudaGoose, there are no combined installs, and one topology must be settled by the show. He says plainly that he had misled the team: "Я ошибочно ввёл вас в заблуждение"; aka cannibalise MudaGoose, no parallel operation (2 sources, updated 2026-09-07)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-07-operating-mode-set-at-build-time-and-nothing-is-deleted.md]] — (Sept-7 2026, active) Dmitri Chudinov's remote runtime mode-switch is rejected: operating mode is flashed at build time in the warehouse, the frozen August-2026 show build is tagged, and **nothing is deleted** — main goes its own way; aka build-time mode, tag the August 2026 show build (2 sources, updated 2026-09-07)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-07-e-wallets-stay-on-the-local-gateway-until-jvl-has-its-own-cloud.md]] — (Sept-7 2026, active) wallets stay on the local gateway until JVL has its own cloud server, ~6 months out; the accepted consequence is that a wallet created at location A never works at location B; aka wallets stay local, location A location B (2 sources, updated 2026-09-07)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-07-the-e-wallet-must-exist-with-a-zero-balance.md]] — (Sept-7 2026, active) a zero-balance wallet must be a valid object — that is what makes it a player card; lifetime is per-location configuration (30/60/90 days or immortal) and the ticket is amount-agnostic; whether to block play on a zero balance is called a **strategy** question, not a technical limit; aka zero-balance wallet, wallet lifetime configurable (2 sources, updated 2026-09-07)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-07-print-the-winnings-ticket-at-the-cashier-over-sas.md]] — (Sept-7 2026, active) Genadi Peari's idea adopted: the Flex-Port sends a SAS command so the winnings ticket prints at the cashier's Flex-IQ printer; Pavel Frolov adds it as a second button at the mandatory cashout step — scan an existing ticket or print a new one; aka print at the cashier, second button at cashout (2 sources, updated 2026-09-07)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-07-one-tito-printer-and-one-paper-for-everything.md]] — (Sept-7 2026, active) one TITO printer and one paper stock for everything — wallet tickets, receipts and short regulator reports, with long reports going by email; TITO kept over Genadi Peari's roll-printer challenge, on 24 volts with the barcode in the safe zone; aka one printer one paper, roll printer rejected (2 sources, updated 2026-09-07)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-07-flex-port-goes-sas-and-jvl-drops-the-old-machine-segment.md]] — (Sept-7 2026, active) the load-bearing one: SAS goes into the current Flex-Port software, one firmware serving three interfaces by configuration, **Georgia is AFT not TITO** — and JVL explicitly concedes the part of the market still running old machines ("мы не будем адресовать ту часть рынка, которая сегодня стоит на старых машинах"); aka Flex-Port goes SAS, dropping the old-machine segment (8 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-07-wi-fi-module-on-flex-port-with-an-external-router.md]] — (Sept-7 2026, active) solder a Wi-Fi module onto the Flex-Port board at ~$4–5/board, but keep a commercial external router as the access point; mesh rejected, the cable stays, routers must be American or allied ("китайские будут запрещены в Америке"), and the antenna must be a **certified** part — a certification constraint, not a physics one; one serial connector dropped. Note the unreconciled module cost against Genadi Peari's $10/board on Aug-24, both recorded with dates; aka soldered Wi-Fi module, mesh rejected (10 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-29-mikrotik-is-the-location-router-and-val-leaves-the-brand-to-the-team.md]] — MikroTik is the location router: Linksys will not boot without internet, Netgear cannot be tested in Belarus, Val restates "no Chinese equipment" and leaves the brand to the team; a switch is needed too, PoE is future-only; aka MikroTik router, микротик, можем с микротиком дальше двигаться, PoE switch (3 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-01-two-fram-chips-come-off-the-current-io-board-and-the-street-machine-board-grows-out-of-a-redesigned-io-board.md]] — Genadi's three-step plan, unobjected by Val: two 256-Mbit FRAM chips ($6 each) not populated on the current IO board, saving $12/board; the IO board redesigned to about half its cost (new memory type, modern USB controller replacing a hard-to-buy one); the street-machine board derived from that redesign with a USB hub, printer/card-dispenser ports and lights; aka $12 per board, не populate, динозавры (2 sources, updated 2026-10-05)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-01-the-street-cabinets-printer-and-acceptor-come-down-onto-the-panel-flex-style-in-plastic-and-the-model-does-not-go-to-igor-yet.md]] — PROPOSAL (no decision yet, owner 2026-10-05): Val, on Genadi's model: the dashboard cannot slide and the paper cannot be loaded, so the printer and acceptor come down onto the drop-down panel as on the Flex, the dashboard halves, the construction is plastic with no metal reinforcement; Genadi's bill-acceptor-tunnel objection stays open; "too early" to hand the model to Igor; Val reopens whether the street machine needs a FlexPort at all; aka devices onto the panel, dashboard halved, ещё рановато (2 sources, updated 2026-10-05)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-30-flex-iq-sound-feedback-and-the-flexpay-slim-led-language-go-to-mvp-2.md]] — Klimovich: the missed Flex IQ sound-feedback capability (speakers are inside) goes to MVP 2, not MVP 1 — "не будем гнаться за паровозами"; MVP 2 must also define the FlexPay slim LED language (colours, logic); Biratka already has sounds on FlexPay; aka звуковое сопровождение, диодный язык, sound to MVP 2 (3 sources, updated 2026-10-05)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-01-sas-or-no-sas-is-set-per-flex-port-on-the-flex-iq-set-up-screen-and-sent-at-registration-with-the-pin-code.md]] — Oct 1 2026: a Flex-Port's SAS / no-SAS mode is a per-port toggle on the Flex IQ set-up screen, not the server (MVP 2 or 3), sent at terminal registration with the PIN code; a port switches only when idle; modes "sas AFT" / "no sas" (Pavel, with Chudinov); aka SAS mode flag, тумблер переключения, no SAS (5 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-02-sas-command-logs-are-collected-on-the-flex-iq-and-not-sent-to-grafana-by-default.md]] — SAS command logs from the machines stay on the Flex IQ, off by default and switchable per machine, read on demand — sending would clog the modem channel; Chudinov reviews weekend traffic (Pavel/Chudinov); aka пускай он лучше не шлёт но собирает (5 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-02-the-diagnostic-tool-goes-onto-the-installation-stick-and-lives-in-the-sdk-repository-both-rk-and-fp7-are-worked-out.md]] — the diagnostic tool ships on the installation USB stick and is built from the SDK repository (always there, always current); read-only so safe to hand out; modem-borne diagnostics wait for use cases and a server side; RK (ARM, street) and FP-7 (x86, casino) both worked out, RK as step 2 (Pavel, Oct 2 2026); aka диагностик тул на флешке, абсолютно безопасен, RK is step 2 (2 sources, updated 2026-10-05)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-05-the-payment-hub-autotest-stand-is-not-mvp1-and-a-separate-meeting-with-andrei-designs-it.md]] — the stand for the InComm card autotests (real vs fake InComm, cloud vs the office, 15–20 GB, who holds it) is "not MVP 1" and goes to a separate meeting with Andrei; positions of Chudinov, Pavel, Tsymanov and Irina recorded, nothing else settled (Oct 5 2026); aka autotest stand debate, стенд для автотестов, эмулятор инкома (5 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-01-mvp2-capabilities-biratka-ports-flex-iqs-to-flexpay-and-writes-no-new-ones-until-klimovich-defines-the-flows.md]] — Oct 1 2026: for MVP 2 Biratka drops the wrong capabilities and ports Flex IQ's to FlexPay by analogy, but writes no new ones until Klimovich (back Oct 13) has thought through the user and administrator flows; aka по аналогии с флекса IQ (7 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-30-elizabeths-georgia-set-up-questions-go-to-a-shared-teams-chat-not-one-person.md]] — Elizabeth's questions during the Georgia test set-up go to a shared Teams chat (Khamin, Pavel, Chudinov, Irina), not one contact; Bosik's single-contact idea rejected by Irina ("Элизабет ещё пишет вечером… кто знает, тот и ответит"); Klimovich creates it; Elizabeth starts Oct 1; aka общий чат, 2 Андрея (4 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-07-wi-fi-provisioning-by-encrypted-qr.md]] — (Sept-7 2026, active) enter Wi-Fi credentials once on the Flex-Pay, then push them to each port by **encrypted** QR — unlike a phone's network-share QR, which hands over the password in clear; install telemetry goes to Grafana cloud logging with offline buffering; aka encrypted QR provisioning (10 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-07-every-jvl-device-must-show-what-it-sees.md]] — (Sept-7 2026, active) every JVL device must be able to show what it sees — an operator dashboard plus an on-device service mode. Val frames it as a standard rather than a feature: "это культура"; aka show what it sees, service mode (2 sources, updated 2026-09-07)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-07-andrei-bosik-drives-the-wi-fi-work-and-the-process-chain.md]] — (Sept-7 2026, active) Andrey Bosik drives the Wi-Fi work, and the process chain is named: no Jira ticket means no work — use cases (Klimovich) → capabilities → features (Pavel) → branch → commit carrying prose and data contracts; aka no Jira no work (7 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-07-error-recovery-and-non-functional-requirements-come-first.md]] — (Sept-7 2026, active) cross-meeting ruling: error recovery and non-functional requirements come before features, each carrying a single-line acceptance criterion (5 sources, updated 2026-09-19)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-07-pin-and-wallet-load-configurable-per-location.md]] — (Sept-7 2026, active) PIN entry and wallet load become per-location configuration rather than fixed product behaviour (2 sources, updated 2026-09-07)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-07-remote-firmware-update-mandatory-and-taken-off-yavorsky.md]] — (Sept-7 2026, active) remote firmware update is mandatory and is **not implemented on the Flex-Port at all**; Val reassigns it away from Eugine Yavorski, giving working difficulty as his stated reason — recorded as his stated reason and explicitly not as a performance or compensation matter per §15.8; aka remote update mandatory (2 sources, updated 2026-09-07)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-07-flex-port-flash-cut-to-two-sixteen-megabyte-blocks.md]] — (Sept-7 2026, active) Flex-Port flash drops from two 64 MB blocks to two 16 MB; the currently-specified chip was last quoted at $148 (2 sources, updated 2026-09-07)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-07-virtual-test-system-tries-full-arm-emulation-first.md]] — (Sept-7 2026, active) the virtual test system attempts full ARM emulation first before any lighter-weight fallback (25 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-04-north-america-modem-variant-and-ask-kore-for-the-apn.md]] — (Sept-4 2026, active) the "7455" LTE modem won't hold a link in Georgia because Minsk's unit came from AliExpress and Georgia's from a different source on different firmware; accept the mismatch, buy the ~$16 North-America variant off Amazon **and** ask KORE for its recommended modems plus the APN, in parallel; two days of tests with Elizabeth had failed to stabilise it; aka 7455 modem, KORE APN (12 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-04-brackets-and-harnesses-from-china-and-a-metal-order-for-one-hundred.md]] — (Sept-4 2026, active) brackets and harnesses are the critical path for the first ten Flex-Slims: rush them from China via Mikhail Perelman, then place a metal order for 100 units at 14 gauge; aka first ten Flex-Slims, metal order for 100 (5 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-04-flex-port-keeps-its-screen.md]] — (Sept-4 2026, active) Val rejects Pavel's screenless SMIB variant — the Flex-Port keeps its screen. **Narrows rather than overturns** the Sept-2 touch-vs-non-touch ruling (Sept-2 set the floor at non-touch; Sept-4 refuses screenless), so both stay active; aka no-screen SMIB variant rejected (2 sources, updated 2026-09-04)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-04-port-the-smib-sas-module-into-the-flex-port-main-branch.md]] — (Sept-4 2026, active — **one sub-element dead, §3 retitle applied**) SAS lives on the SMIB, not the Flex-Port — carry the software module across and merge it straight into main rather than polishing it; scope from Dmitri Chudinov's SAS-command document; estimated at "a couple-three days", not the half-hour first suggested. On Monday Sept-7 the "Yavorski on Monday evening" element **died** (Val took the task off him) and Alekseev's weekend merge was never reported done; both removed from the headline and named as dead in the status note, while the core ruling survives. The open question "is Chudinov's command list sufficient?" was **answered: no — it covers TITO, and Georgia needs AFT**; aka SAS on Flex-Port, merge into main branch (6 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-04-georgia-v4-mechanical-button-deck.md]] — (Sept-4 2026, active) the Georgia V4 gets a **mechanical button deck** with bet up/down defaulting to $1 (against JVL's 25¢ — Aristocrat's dollar default is "four to one") and a dual box in place of the nudge; the larger dashboard was dropped; deck cost ~$120; aka V4 direction, "default to a dollar" (4 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-04-d27-discontinued-curve-c43-premium-line.md]] — (Sept-4 2026, active) the **D27 is discontinued**, the V43 runs ~3 more years, and the **C43 Curve** becomes the premium line — to be shown at the next Georgia show built on NOVA; note Nebraska is "the last release for OnRage"; aka D27 discontinued, Curve 43 (2 sources, updated 2026-09-04)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-01-first-nova-product-south-dakota-vlt-2.md]] — (Sept-1 2026, active) **OWNER RULING**: the first product on NOVA is **South Dakota VLT-2** — the direct Rage→NOVA migration track, not the South Dakota Vertical 01 of the Aug-14 sequencing decision, whose titular claim this supersedes. Selects track (a) of the two candidates Val floated Aug-26; track (b) (a Georgia COAM version on D27, not vertical) is not abandoned, just not first. Nebraska-on-Rage, Georgia V3 on the current platform, Lena building in parallel and the three new vertical games all still stand. Owner ruling = its own citation (§16), no raw source. Certification ruled the same day, two GLI items kept separate: **Sept-1 2026 is the RAGE-based SD VLT-2 submission (NOT NOVA)**, slipped ~2 days in execution (actual ≈ Sept 3) — a slip, NOT a re-plan (owner: "the original schedule should not be changed, but the factual date should be acknowledged"); **NOVA has NO GLI date yet** (the Aug-18 ~Nov-1 target lapsed, nothing replaces it); **Calle Ocho is "no more" the certification vehicle**. (4 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-08-18-nova-math-container-per-game-set.md]] — (Aug-18 2026, active) math-as-a-service Docker packaging: **build the math container from a game list passed in at the integration-build step, one container per game set/market**; rejected the all-games container and a fully self-configuring container (both premature); per-game checksums for certification; exact build mechanics TBD in practice (2 sources, updated 2026-08-21)

- [[wiki/decisions/2025-04-24-omni-first-release-legacy-plus-remote-setup-screens.md]] — first Omni GLI release (target June 1) ships legacy setup screens + config unchanged plus new React remote/USB initial-setup screens; the rest stay legacy; IP 853 repo, Bitbucket→GitHub, per-screen Figma serial IDs (1 source, updated 2026-07-16)
- [[wiki/decisions/2025-02-01-online-games-derive-from-land-based-mechanics.md]] — online games are built from land-based mechanics on a separate production line (not ported); land-based is priority (1 source, updated 2026-07-13)
- [[wiki/decisions/2025-02-28-fortune-foo-paws-second-math-pack.md]] — produce a second Fortune Foo Paws math pack with Chinese bet levels (88–888) to A/B on the floor; treat as "math pack two" / a separate GLI approval (1 source, updated 2026-07-13)
- [[wiki/decisions/2025-02-28-hg6-individual-progressive-by-denomination.md]] — HG-6 CPU kits get an individual progressive per denomination (no more max-denom-only limit); higher progressive on the highest enabled denom; ~2–3 weeks (1 source, updated 2026-07-13)
- [[wiki/decisions/2025-03-07-final-signoff-on-assembled-machines.md]] — games must be signed off on final assembled/packaged machines shipped from the Georgia office (Lena/Michael/Juan), not open racks/PCs; triggered by a Calle Ocho stutter bug (1 source, updated 2026-07-13)
- [[wiki/decisions/2025-04-14-calle-ocho-first-omni-framework-game.md]] — port the just-released Calle Ocho as the FIRST game on the Omni framework (pin the apple still), target June 1 for GLI; port order base game→dashboard→tilts/big-wins; math to container form (Efim); full setup screens required (Hrybko); Apr-17 naming ruling ("Kayo Ocho Omni", hyphenated) + middle asset-port method + keep deploying current Coyote; + the Apr-14 origin meeting ("pin the apple, don't shoot it in the air", fake Diamond Link bonus, daily 6:30am, Dima Khandov's 3× math slip); aka Calle Ocho Omni (6 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2025-05-30-jackpot-rush-any-bet-and-denomination-scheduler.md]] — remove the max-bet-required condition on Jackpot Rush ("JPRE") so progressives are eligible at any bet (Georgia version already is; Florida needs a math redesign); AND build a denomination-scheduler capability across games (bet levels by time-of-day/day-of-week; Interblock precedent; Val to research patent); aka JPRE any bet, denom scheduler (1 source, updated 2026-07-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-20-the-vertical-geometry-standard-glossary-and-adrs-go-to-github-outside-any-framework.md]] — Val overrules Pavel (Sept-20 2026): the vertical geometry standard, glossary and ADRs go into GitHub "in a vacuum", outside any framework; ADRs extracted from transcripts by Claude; order GitHub → end-to-end tests → timed RAGE-to-NOVA conversion; due Thursday Sept 24; designers kept out (4 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-21-at-the-counter-no-printer-no-wallet-at-the-port-the-wallet-goes-to-unclaimed.md]] — Sept-21 2026 (MVP 1): no paper in the printer — at the counter Flex IQ checks the printer first and creates no wallet; at the Flex-Port the wallet is created and goes to unclaimed, printed later by the cashier (2 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-22-autotests-go-inside-the-existing-capabilities-and-the-first-e2e-test-is-a-one-hour-micro-step.md]] — Sept-22 2026 (MVP 1): autotest features go inside the existing capabilities, not a separate one; the first E2E test is a Flex-Port connection check read through the telnet hook (capability 173, Khamin, due Sept 23); JVL's own equipment tested first (4 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-23-open-requirements-are-settled-on-the-call-and-only-slow-ones-are-parked.md]] — Sept-23 2026 (MVP 1): open requirements are settled on the call — REQ-753 deleted, no fixed disconnect timeouts, no PIN lockout on Flex IQ, REQ-1550 kept with an ADR, plain ESL English, lost money → a "forfeit" wallet; only a question taking more than a minute is parked (4 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-24-a-flex-port-that-dies-holding-money-sends-it-to-unclaimed-and-one-without-a-gateway-goes-out-of-service.md]] — Sept-24 2026 (MVP 1): a Flex-Port that dies holding money keeps the transaction and sends it to unclaimed on return (bug 349); no gateway link → out of service, money stays on the machine (bug 354); cashier actions on unclaimed money → MVP 2 (8 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-25-the-conversion-experiment-closes-and-the-converter-gets-its-own-project-and-repository.md]] — Val (Sept-25 2026): the conversion experiment closes in a day or two; standards go to the knowledge standards folder, ADRs sit next to the code; the converter (finite life) gets its own Jira project and repository; scripts in a tools folder; capabilities closed retroactively; repositories before Jira projects (4 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-25-georgia-machines-go-out-at-92-percent-and-the-progressive-tops-are-2400-2400-1500.md]] — Val (Sept-25 2026): Georgia machines go out at 92% ("good enough right now"; 96.5% was a mistake); progressive top awards Match 3 $2,400, Fiery Ice $2,400, Jackpot Rush $1,500 (4 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-28-october-15-replaces-october-1-as-the-mvp1-date.md]] — (SUPERSEDED Oct-18 by owner ruling: transactional MVP 1 release date is **November 1 2026**) Sept-28 2026: October 15 replaced October 1 as the working MVP 1 date (consensus of Pavel, Klimovich and Val — "будем честны, что у нас 15 число"); final state by then "if possible" (95% fine); autotests ~October 23; a ~10-location trial batch floated (13 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-05-geometry-first-port-autotests-accepted-and-geometry-checks-named-graphic-contracts.md]] — Val approves geometry-then-scenario autotests for same-format game ports; the geometry checks are called "graphic contracts"; the transition defect is not yet caught (Oct 5 2026); aka graphic contracts, мутационное тестирование (2 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-05-horizontal-to-vertical-conversion-runs-in-parallel-with-the-port-autotests.md]] — Igor keeps the port autotests and, in parallel, converts Dragon Pays horizontal↔vertical; scale-and-stack vs templates left open (Oct 5 2026); aka pay-table templates, H↔V in parallel (6 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-05-flex-port-and-connection-settings-screens-live-under-the-admin-role-not-the-cashier.md]] — the capability-141 Flex-Port and connection-settings screens have no mock-ups, sit under the admin role (not the cashier) and copy the Recycler's port display (Oct 5 2026); aka под ролью админа (2 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-05-mvp1-has-no-print-queue-and-tickets-print-or-reprint-from-records.md]] — no print queue in MVP 1; tickets print or reprint from Records; FlexPay self-service printing is not MVP 1 (Oct 5 2026, Klimovich); aka без очереди (2 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-05-epic-950-is-the-terminal-printer-tested-first-and-all-models-stay-supported.md]] — the Epic 950 is the priority terminal printer and the one tested now; all models stay supported; Pavel writes the requirement (Oct 5 2026); aka Epic Edge, printer models (4 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-05-ris-improvement-mvp1-is-five-jira-capabilities-in-one-release-due-october-19.md]] — the RIS improvement MVP 1 cut: CAP-252/255/246/250/254 in one release due Oct 19; no non-functional requirements, no LTE modem, lottery lock left out (Oct 5 2026); aka RIS improvement MVP1, release date set for 19th (5 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-05-the-critical-error-screen-shows-the-cause-and-fix-in-words-and-keeps-the-qr-code-in-mvp1.md]] — the critical-error screen returns to MVP 1: cause and fix in words plus the QR code; QR data goes to a non-real-time JVL database (Oct 5 2026; supersedes Sept 28); aka critical error screen, the QR code is for JVL (5 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-06-the-ris-mvp1-changes-are-built-for-georgia-only-on-the-1-14-svn-line-with-nothing-else-added.md]] — the RIS MVP 1 changes go to Kharetski first and are built for Georgia only, on the 1.14 SVN line with nothing else added; the statistics carousel is dropped (Oct 6 2026); aka RIS Georgia branch, карусель для лизы (13 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-06-mudagoose-is-removed-from-the-code-entirely-and-git-history-is-the-way-back.md]] — Chudinov removes MudaGoose (screens, mode, tests, old Payment Hub parts) from the code; git history is the way back (Oct 6 2026); aka Mutagus, мутагусь, PORT-82 (4 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-08-game-scenes-are-assembled-by-developers-with-claude-from-designer-resources-not-by-designers.md]] — developers assemble game scenes with Claude from designer resources and the comp, not designers by hand; Igor's 1920×2160 master-video spec (Oct 8 2026, Val insists); aka Claude-built scenes, one resource set for both layouts (2 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-08-texas-rage-games-convert-to-vertical-nova-unchanged-and-igor-ports-dutch-mill-first.md]] — horizontal Texas RAGE games convert to vertical NOVA with Igor's 20% stretch, maths and function unchanged; Igor ports Dutch Mill first (target Oct 19); supersedes Sept 14 (Oct 8 2026); aka Texas blind conversion, в тупую слепую (11 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-08-class-a-party-time-may-start-on-the-paid-spin-after-free-spins-and-lions-riches-is-the-single-target.md]] — Class A: party time may start on the paid spin after free spins; Lions Riches is the single target game; requirements IP-1220 due Oct 16 (Oct 8 2026); aka party time after free spins, IP-1220 (2 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-08-dual-box-for-nebraska-class-a-and-georgia-five-reel-and-no-smaller-touch-area-for-the-wrong-coin.md]] — dual box for Nebraska, Class A and Georgia 5-reel games, placed lower above the button panel; Georgia 3-reel nudge still open; no smaller touch area for the wrong coin (Oct 8 2026); aka dual box placement, 3-reel nudge (2 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-09-all-web-services-go-to-production-before-the-weekend-instead-of-waiting-for-georgia.md]] — roll out all web services to production now; Chudinov deploys over the weekend instead of waiting for Georgia (Oct 9 2026); aka раскатить веб сервисы все (7 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-09-a-real-transaction-is-run-in-production-on-the-new-version-before-the-first-real-location.md]] — a real transaction is run in production on the new version before the first real location, likely the week of Oct 12 (Oct 9 2026, Bosik/Klimovich); aka реальную транзакцию (2 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-09-one-machines-bad-statistics-must-stop-blocking-the-statistics-host-and-a-task-is-opened.md]] — one machine's bad statistics must stop blocking the statistics host; a task is opened, no fix chosen (Oct 9 2026); aka statistics host blocked (2 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-09-first-borrowed-operator-machines-are-arranged-for-october-15-16.md]] — the first borrowed operator machines are arranged for Oct 15–16 (Klimovich with Felipe); MVP 1 development "formally" done (Oct 9 2026); aka borrowed machines October 15–16 (5 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-09-a-terminal-registered-before-must-wipe-its-secrets-and-the-install-instruction-says-so-in-red.md]] — a terminal registered before must wipe its secrets (each letter pressed 4 times); the install instruction says so in red (Oct 9 2026); aka зачистить секреты (2 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-12-ris-server-side-capabilities-251-and-253-can-follow-a-submitted-build-without-resubmitting.md]] — RIS server-side capabilities 251 and 253 can be added after a build is submitted, without resubmitting (Oct 12 2026, Felipe); aka add it after without submitting again (2 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-12-sebastian-writes-a-cash-out-only-log-capability-for-ris-mvp2.md]] — Sebastian writes a cash-out-only log capability, a candidate for RIS MVP 2 (Oct 12 2026); aka cash out only screen (4 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-12-build-4333-is-tested-in-the-office-on-the-sas-simulator-for-the-intralot-lock-unlock-problem.md]] — build 4333 is tested in the office on the IGT SAS simulator for the lock Intralot cannot clear (Oct 12 2026); aka Intralot lock, Megahits 4333 (4 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-12-a-ris-that-needs-a-printer-still-installs-on-a-machine-without-one-and-the-machine-tilts-until-a-printer-is-added-or-unchecked.md]] — working position (not final): a RIS that needs a printer still installs on a machine without one, and the machine tilts until a printer is added or unchecked (Oct 12 2026, Pavel); aka RIS requires printer (2 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-14-mvp1-is-extended-to-about-november-8-or-9-and-the-mvp2-marked-tasks-are-done-inside-it.md]] — MVP 1 is extended to about Nov 8 or 9 and the MVP 2-marked tasks are done inside it — the RIS improvement MVP 1 (owner-confirmed 2026-10-15) (Oct 14 2026, Pavel/Irina); aka MVP1 extension (6 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-14-no-freeze-inside-a-game-so-a-games-videos-are-decoded-when-the-game-is-entered.md]] — no freeze is allowed inside a game, so a game's videos are decoded when the game is entered; about 5 games may fit in 8 GB on the RK3576 (Oct 14 2026); aka decode at game entry (3 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-14-transactional-mvp1-counts-as-released-only-when-the-end-to-end-acceptance-tests-pass.md]] — Val (Oct 14 2026): no product-team test pass now; transactional MVP 1 is released only when the end-to-end acceptance tests pass; "November 9" was the RIS MVP 1 date (owner, Oct 18); aka MVP1 released only after end-to-end tests (4 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-14-the-first-ten-transactional-locations-go-in-from-november-1-on-stock-monitors-ports-without-wi-fi-and-hand-made-harnesses.md]] — Nov 1 stays: stock monitors, ports without Wi-Fi, JVL-made brackets for the first location (Sebastian finds a distributor), 10 harness sets made by hand, max 2 installs a day, pause after 10; aka path to the first ten locations (8 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-14-jvl-sets-the-location-daily-cap-backs-it-with-a-guarantor-account-and-a-card-and-the-automatic-location-block-is-mvp-1-5.md]] — JVL sets the daily cap as InComm's guarantor; guarantor account and card per location; escalation by notices, then secondary account, then master; the automatic location block becomes "MVP 1.5"; aka MVP 1.5, Daily Cap устанавливаем мы (4 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-14-the-first-cloud-step-is-a-backup-of-each-flex-iq.md]] — first cloud step is a two-day backup of each Flex IQ unit; dashboard likely MVP 3; aka per-unit backup (2 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-18-every-gap-found-on-another-makers-machine-becomes-requirements-and-the-machine-emulator-keeps-a-mode-per-maker.md]] — Val (Oct 18): every gap found on another maker's machine becomes requirements with acceptance criteria, code and prose, and the machine emulator keeps one mode per maker; Pavel and Irina enforce it; Aristocrat fixed, IGT mishandles the SAS lock command; aka emulator per maker, IGT lock command (6 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-18-rage-is-closed-dutch-mill-reaches-nova-by-wednesday-and-a-reskin-from-a-new-theme-tests-the-tools.md]] — Val (Oct 18): RAGE is finished, all work on NOVA; first NOVA Dutch Mill reviewed Wed Oct 21; Michael writes a theme abstract from Igor's spec for a re-skin test; ~15 h per game estimate; aka Dutch Mill re-skin, theme abstract (10 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-18-igors-spec-becomes-a-creative-direction-specification-for-game-designers-and-the-word-re-skin-is-dropped.md]] — Val (Oct 18): Igor's spec is renamed a creative direction specification for game designers (vertical NOVA screen); "re-skin" is banned; positions in pixels and percent, a taxonomy table, each point written fully in Russian first; aka creative direction specification (2 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-21-nova-drops-the-browser-for-a-native-engine-no-code-before-capabilities-and-mvp1-is-a-stable-nova-releasing-six-texas-games.md]] — Val (Oct 21): NOVA drops the browser and Pixi for its own native engine (Leshkevich's Rust prototype ~700 MB vs 2,700 MB); no code before capabilities, requirements, acceptance criteria and a readable architecture; MVP 1 = a stable NOVA releasing six Texas games, 10 days at most; reverses Sept 4; aka native engine, drop the browser (3 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-21-vladimir-samusenko-is-invited-as-nova-product-owner-and-capabilities-are-drafted-one-file-per-person-before-grooming.md]] — Oct 21: Vladimir Samusenko invited as product owner of the new NOVA (writes no code on it); Pavel writes the role and meets him Mon Oct 26; each engineer drafts capabilities in one file in a new repo, grooming from Tue Oct 27; aka NOVA product owner (2 sources, updated 2026-10-24)

### Markets & Product

- [[wiki/decisions/2024-11-06-website-online-first-brand-registry-for-echo.md]] — website releases lead with the online-games module; ECHO presented via Amazon Brand Registry instead of an own site; fix-price releases 1–2 first (1 source, updated 2026-07-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2024-11-24-engage-flexpay-discovery-contractor.md]] — engage a Poland/Belarus contractor for a ~$8k FlexPay discovery phase (spec + mockups → fixed-price build); as-of Nov 2024, later engagement unconfirmed (1 source, updated 2026-07-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-06-10-texas-legal-read-comes-through-an-operator-never-in-writing.md]] — JVL's Texas product gets vetted by a **verbal, feature-level read from Stephen Fenoglio obtained through an operator — never a written opinion**, because his Pace-O-Matic retainer is a conflict ("I cannot give a binding legal opinion for any other company… I can't put it in writing"); Val took the route around it in the same breath ("So we can come to you through an operator") and did not press for written counsel; **confirmed in practice Jun-23** when Jordan Barberio offered to present a JVL machine as the operator ("we've gone through fifty or more games together in the past fifteen years"); the cost is named but unanswered — a relied-upon Texas opinion needs conflict-free counsel, and none is named anywhere in the corpus; status active (3 sources, updated 2026-09-19)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-06-18-jvl-moves-its-south-dakota-office-to-nebraska.md]] — Val decides in the room at MG Oil to **move JVL's regional office out of South Dakota to Nebraska**, hold parts and spare machines in MG Oil's own warehouse cage, and send a technician in monthly; the South Dakota office is leased **month-to-month from Troy Erickson**, MG Oil's owner, which is what makes the move cheap to take; status active with the **Nebraska half unverified** — no later source shows a Nebraska office actually opening, and an Aug-26-2026 source has the South Dakota office closed with its bench shipped to Georgia instead (recorded, not resolved) (3 sources, updated 2026-09-19)
- [[wiki/decisions/2025-01-07-pursue-mg-oil-south-dakota.md]] — pursue the MG Oil / South Dakota route opportunity (~200 locations); May-13 the intro landed — Troy Erikson / MG Oil (still active) (2 sources, updated 2026-07-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2025-03-14-base-nebraska-on-georgia-conservative-nudge.md]] — build Nebraska off existing Georgia Peach 1/2/3, hands removed + nudge reverted to conservative, keeping dual-SAS/TITO/VDEC/touch; four packs of six; regulator-first, prefer Eclipse; nudge choice REVERSED May 8, then **nudge ABANDONED entirely May 15** (NE attorney: not skill) → power-slider skill overlay (3 sources, updated 2026-07-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2025-03-19-minimal-touch-fix-in-rage-defer-to-omni.md]] — minimal touch fix in Rage now (narrowed perimeters, buttons shifted; VDEC gray-screen timeout scope-gap fix; Lena to narrow all games per GQAM); affirmative touch/swipe = technical requirement for Omni; emitter/button swap no-go; ~mid-Apr Omni driver-architecture agenda (date inferred) (1 source, updated 2026-07-15)
- [[wiki/decisions/2025-03-28-flexpay-support-tito-non-jvl-locations.md]] — FlexPay to issue/validate TITO tickets at non-JVL locations via FlexPort-as-SMIB + a "Flex SAS server" proxy (SAS↔WSS); cheap 9-bit adapter route rejected; gap discovered Mar 27; refined Apr-7 into the FlexSMIB/FlexPort split (4 sources, updated 2026-07-15)
- [[wiki/decisions/2025-04-07-flexsmib-modern-flexport-legacy.md]] — TITO locations need two devices: screenless **FlexSMIB** in modern dual-SAS machines, screened **FlexPort** in legacy machines (no player-facing errors otherwise); scanner stays; TITO beta ~Apr 30; 4 FlexPay+16 FlexPort to Georgia, 1+2 to Florida, ship next day → Apr-8 evolution: ship Thursday, arrive Monday; ship split revised down to 8 FlexPort+2 FlexPay GA / 2+1 FL (only ~12 FlexPorts exist); Apr-23 evolution: SMIB needed only for dual-SAS+TITO (digital-wallet locations are FlexPort-only), local TITO server becomes its own standalone industrial-Linux product (5 sources, updated 2026-07-15)
- [[wiki/decisions/2025-04-01-price-georgia-coam-upgrade-kits.md]] — charge for the Georgia COAM software-upgrade kits (first time): ~$2,900 retail, ~$2,500 floor; kits have ~zero bill-of-material so finance generously (12–24 mo, zero-interest) only against kiosk orders, under a signed repossession contract; Elevate for 5-yr third-party financing; Val's 2026 "kiosk vacuum" market-sizing (2 sources, updated 2026-07-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2025-04-03-license-software-per-operator-not-machine.md]] — license machine software per operator by installation count (per-seat/concurrent-install), not per machine/hardware; enforce in the RIS manager fed by Business Central invoice data (Lev exports, Chudinov consumes); software warranty ~3 mo from invoice date; invoice=final-sale/lease-until-zero-collateral; Georgia-first, moving-forward only; aka RIS manager, InChat, software licensing model (1 source, updated 2026-07-15)
- [[wiki/decisions/2025-05-27-release-ewallet-mvp-first.md]] — release the e-Wallet MVP first (Georgia QAM), build TITO in parallel — the money-cycle is reusable; Nov-2025 hard deadline; freeze/rename version "17b", JCM-UBA-only, Bitbucket→GitHub in ~1 week, twice-weekly cadence, In-House full-cycle test (Incom+JVL bank) at Philippe's Georgia office; + the full-SAS-no-truncation ruling (Pavel dissent noted); aka e-wallet first, full SAS no truncation (4 sources, updated 2026-07-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2025-05-28-class3-meters-constitution-georgia-parallel-logic.md]] — Class-3 metering is implemented purely (the "constitution"); Georgia QAM (and every jurisdiction) gets a separate parallel "legislation" logic layered on top (hands-validated partial jackpot payout), never by altering Class-3 meters; verify Class-3 first; Juan drafts requirements, reconvene ~10 days; Jun-10 reconvene reaffirmed it + found the key-to-meter scope gaps; Jun-17 Class-3 tests 1&2 pass + ~300-meter table, Georgia-QAM flow next; aka jackpot limit, key-to-credit, constitution-vs-legislation (3 sources, updated 2026-07-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2025-08-14-backend-architecture-block-diagram-first-mvp.md]] — Aug-14 backend-architecture ruling: everything built on Omni; draw a **block-diagram of WHAT the system does (not HOW)** first, then carve MVPs/use cases; transactional products = **calendar** priority (July-1-2026 Georgia deadline, Jan-2026 beta) not architectural priority; business reqs = hot-swap/one-day-ACH/immediate-fraud-lockout; phased plan (Phase-1 MVP Jan-2026 transactional [Nathan+Juan] + minimal CMS [Pavel] + HHR deferred [Will]; Oct-15 CMS modernization; Nov-15 HHR/advanced) + Wed/Fri Architecture Discovery Team; aka block diagram first, transactional MVP (2 sources, updated 2026-07-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-08-21-release-flex-iq-as-is-place-units-collect-facts.md]] — release Flex IQ in its current configuration (no split, no replay) and place 20–50 units to collect factual field data; feature requests parked, not dismissed; the only competitor is PAX (~5,000 GA locations); add barcode reading for wrapped InComm cards; Juan and Andrei dissented on split; aka park replay and split, factual not hypothetical (3 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-08-21-keep-jvl-dollars-printed-serialized-cards.md]] — keep "JVL Dollars" as designed: physical serialized barcode cards, 12-month expiry, redeemable against any JVL product, verified by a simple database, deliberately NOT booked as an account credit (a credit is a balance-sheet liability); over Felipe's repackaging and Andrei's "call it a credit line"; modeled on an unnamed Miami restaurant chain's dollar programme; aka JVL cash, dollars not discounts (3 sources, updated 2026-08-21)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-08-21-cell-modem-on-every-machine-from-september-1.md]] — from September 1 2026 every shipped machine gets the cell modem and SIM installed, but the modem is activated only for customers who sign the data-sharing agreement; first applied to the ARC 5+15 order; aka modem and SIM from September 1 (5 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-08-21-convert-vertical-machines-instead-of-new-trials.md]] — convert a master's under-performing vertical machines to the new software free, conditional on installing JVL's cell modem, instead of giving away new machines on trial; Bulldog Gaming's 90-day trial (5 frozen machines back mid-October, Brian Deaton decides in January) is the named exception; classify the pipeline by temperature AND market influence; probably don't approach cold prospects; aka convert not trial, trials are the exception (2 sources, updated 2026-08-21)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-08-24-free-hardware-fixed-monthly-fee-model.md]] — give the operator all the transactional hardware free and charge a fixed ~$60–90/month (Val's reference $65), handing the per-transaction dollar back to the operator; market maths 42,000 machines / 7,400 locations / 5.9 per location, ~$320–380 hardware per location, 5–6 month payback, ~$455K/month across ~7,000 locations; stage 2 (drop Flex IQ for a mobile cashier app) considered not decided; aka $65 per month model, profit centre not cost centre (3 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-08-26-add-88-percent-rtp-option-to-georgia-coam-games.md]] — (Aug-26 2026, active) add a lower (~88%) RTP option to the 15 Georgia COAM games and fold it into the Sept-1 release; aka 88 percent RTP option, Georgia 88% option, lower RTP Georgia COAM (2 sources, updated 2026-08-26)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-08-26-certify-only-flex-iq-and-flex-port-with-incomm.md]] — (Aug-26 2026, active) JVL certifies only TWO products with InComm for the next 12 months — Flex IQ and Flex Port; a declaration made to InComm, with ATM-operator licensing as a separate precondition; aka two products with InComm, 12-month product declaration (2 sources, updated 2026-08-26)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-08-26-no-cash-from-coam-redemption-device-for-skill-pay.md]] — (Aug-26 2026, active) InComm's ruling — no cash out of a COAM redemption device for a Skill Pay card, and no coordinated kiosk+ATM pair from the same entity; driven by Georgia Lottery counsel Joe Kim's expo reaction; what remains allowable is spelled out; InComm calls it time-bound but gives no single horizon (Jason "three to five years", Adam "Two years from now"), firm for 2026–27; aka InComm ATM posture, separate device rule (4 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
