- [[wiki/decisions/2026-08-26-narayani-three-machine-d27-trade-in-pilot.md]] — (Aug-26 2026, active — **price RE-OPENED Sept-1 and still unsigned**) trade in three Narayani D27s at **$5,000 each** — $4,000 machine plus $1,000 for a three-year data contract — against new D43s at $14,500 (the D27s were bought at $13,200); the full ~25-machine swap offered only on condition that JVL transactional equipment goes in too, bundle valued at $1,000 per unit and included. **§3 retitle:** on Sept-1 Val's own account of what he agreed on Aug-26 contradicts the Aug-26 record of his own words ("I think you asked for five thousand and I agreed to three thousand"), so the headline no longer asserts a settled $5,000; both claims sit under `## Open contradictions`, unresolved; aka D27 trade-in, 25-machine swap condition (4 sources, updated 2026-09-01)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-08-27-flex-iq-multiple-clearinghouses-selectable-per-device.md]] — (Aug-27 2026, active) Flex-IQ must support multiple clearing houses, selectable per device at registration rather than InComm hard-wired — explicitly NOT in the MVP, and don't approach other clearinghouses yet; use case is the daily-cap / second-provider need Andrei brought back; aka clearinghouse selection per device, provider switching (3 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-01-flex-pay-onto-rk3568.md]] — (Sept-1 2026, active) Flex-Pay is rebuilt onto the **RK3568** platform (the platform with a full build system), targeting the 15th; Alexander Biratka's assignment on returning from vacation; aka Flex-Pay on RK3568 (2 sources, updated 2026-09-05)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-02-activate-incomm-cards-by-barcode-on-flex-iq.md]] — (Sept-2 2026, active) Flex-IQ activates sealed InComm cards **by barcode** (card and envelope carry the same barcode; scanner rotated 90° and aimed downward on the front panel), and reports **drop the 16-digit card number** in favour of the barcode identifier; discharges the Aug-21 wrapped-card blocker without using any of the options floated then; aka barcode activation (2 sources, updated 2026-09-05)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-02-implicit-consent-and-mandatory-printed-receipt.md]] — (Sept-2 2026, active) **activating the card is the player's consent** — nothing is accepted on screen — a printed receipt becomes mandatory, the harness rolls back to v1 with a printer switcher, and the second screen is retired; aka implicit consent, mandatory receipt (3 sources, updated 2026-09-19)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-02-e-wallets-move-to-the-cloud.md]] — (Sept-2 2026, active — **timing superseded Sept-7, direction intact**) e-wallets move to the cloud, "это даже не обсуждается", and must survive a hardware swap at the location. On Sept-7 Val deferred the move ~6 months to JVL's own server: wallets stay on the local gateway until then, with the accepted limit that a wallet created at location A never works at location B. §11 evolution, not contradiction — nobody argued against the cloud; aka wallets stay local, cloud deferred six months (4 sources, updated 2026-09-07)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-02-flex-port-sas-universal-with-scanner-touch-vs-non-touch.md]] — (Sept-2 2026, active) the Flex-Port family splits at **touch vs non-touch**; the SAS variant is universal, the port must carry a scanner, and the cheap SAS SMIB board (~2 MB flash, flash-once) **cannot be re-flashed remotely**; JVL will not chase the ~10% of the market without a second SAS; aka Flex-Port SAS universal (2 sources, updated 2026-09-05)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-02-val-proposes-fifty-percent-of-play-payments.md]] — (Sept-2 2026, **proposal only — not accepted**) Val proposes taking 50% of Play Payments ("I get fifty percent of your company… sleep on it"), on a $5bn→20%→$1bn→$150M arithmetic chain the page records **without repairing** (0.5% of $1bn is $5M, not $150M); the cash-handling and front-fee terms were disputed and Billy's counter-condition was supplier exclusivity — no InComm, no physical card dispensing — which Val called "a big ask. Maybe even impossible"; titled and status-lined so no reader mistakes it for a deal; aka fifty percent of your company (4 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-02-free-ports-and-pos-with-every-machine-bought.md]] — (Sept-2 2026, active) buy-my-way-in offer to Lucky Coin: a $15,750 machine carrying ~$7,000 of free transactional hardware (ports and POS) plus $90 per **location** per month — "doesn't matter if it's three games or nine games" — netting out at roughly just under $9,000; aka buying my way in, ninety dollars per location — stands (owner ruling 2026-10-05: the Sept-29 lease idea is a proposal under consideration, no decision) (28 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-29-pitch-the-transactional-equipment-as-a-lease-with-set-terms-and-a-buy-out-or-return-not-as-free.md]] — PROPOSAL (no decision yet, owner 2026-10-05): the transactional equipment is pitched as a lease with set terms and a buy-out or return at the end — "we do nothing for free; $150 minimum" — with 3/4/5/7/10-year terms to be modelled (Larry proposed, Val adopted); aka lease not free, BMW lease, $150 minimum (5 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-30-one-jv-entity-a-florida-llc-50-50-with-a-special-allocation-of-depreciation-and-jvl-invoices-the-real-4000.md]] — PROPOSAL (no decision yet, owner 2026-10-05): one JV entity (a Florida LLC opened by "Gabe"), 50/50, depreciation specially allocated and resettable yearly; JVL invoices the real $4,000, no inflated values, no note — supersedes the Entity A/B and $12,000-note models; aka one entity not two, no gymnastics whatsoever, invoice us 4K instead of 12 (2 sources, updated 2026-10-05)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-30-a-100-machine-trial-first-then-bell-bank-seacoast-and-possibly-incomm-finance-the-rest.md]] — PROPOSAL (no decision yet, owner 2026-10-05): a 100-machine trial (more if JVL can) as proof of concept; then Larry takes it to Bell Bank/Seacoast (about one third down, note repaid inside the company) and possibly InComm with a first right of refusal; Val: self-financing past ~1,000 installations; aka 100 machine trial, financial toll booth, first right of refusal (4 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-01-the-purchase-order-is-cut-to-100-units-not-300-or-200.md]] — Val cuts Mikhail's purchase order to 100 units (not 300, not 200): no benefit in more and no money tied up; part not named; supplier on holiday to Oct 7, lead time now a month minimum; Val wants the supplier contact himself; aka PO cut to 100 units, мне хватит 100 (2 sources, updated 2026-10-05)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-02-hold-the-recycler-back-but-sign-no-undertaking.md]] — (Sept-2 2026, active) Val accepts InComm's red line and holds the recycler back, but **refuses to sign any letter of undertaking**; InComm settles for asking the question instead. Widens the Aug-26 no-cash ruling: a separate device "ten steps away" is now refused too, and the penalty escalates from card supply to the partnership itself; aka recycler standoff, ten steps away (9 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-02-card-to-machine-launches-with-the-location-as-merchant-of-record.md]] — (Sept-2 2026, active) card-to-machine goes live with the **location** as merchant of record: a 5% fee capped at $50 per chip, paid by the player, with Nuvei enrolment; the economics rest on a $40 barcode scanner against a $300 card reader across ~50,000 non-PCI machines; aka card to machine, Van 19 (2 sources, updated 2026-09-02)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-08-31-dixie-defers-kiosk-investment-until-the-rules-settle.md]] — (Aug-31 2026, active) **operator-side** ruling, not JVL's: Dixie buys no kiosk or transactional equipment until the regulator, the lawmakers and the manufacturers settle the rules — the five-year gift-card timeline, the silence expected through the November midterms, the January reckoning, and the GBI and county sheriffs as the actual enforcers rather than the Lottery; aka kiosk wait and see, January reckoning (4 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-08-31-transactional-equipment-only-with-location-exclusivity.md]] — (Aug-31 2026, active) JVL will place transactional equipment **only** where it has exclusivity in the location plus remote shut-off — MudaGoose comes out, the system is rewired to JVL, a JVL point-of-sale device replaces PAX, Flex ports go inside the machines; the arithmetic behind it is $1 per card against $2,000 defaults, and "there is no money in selling kiosks — the value is recurring revenue"; sits in tension with the Aug-26/27 pitches that offered Flex-IQ *alongside* MudaGoose, flagged as an open question rather than superseding them; aka exclusivity in the location, one dollar per card (20 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-08-31-class-a-deal-with-arc-within-three-months.md]] — (Aug-31 2026, active) Val commits in the room to a Georgia **Class A** deal with ARC Gaming — "I will have a deal within three months… Three months. Give me three months. January." The three-months-vs-January arithmetic gap is recorded, not reconciled; JVL has no Class A regulations in hand at the time of the commitment; aka Class A commitment to ARC (8 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-08-31-arc-kiosk-board-swap-routed-through-the-ceo.md]] — (Aug-31 2026, active) for ARC's kiosk estate: keep the shell, bin the PC board, strip the per-machine printers in favour of barcode readers, add one kiosk printer — and route the proposal through CEO **David Sloan**, never through "Bill"; the existing kiosk agreement is a 20-year deal a previous ARC CEO signed with his own company (vendor EXIO); aka ARC kiosk board swap, David Sloan routing (4 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-08-31-convenience-store-trade-shows-as-a-channel.md]] — (Aug-31 2026, active) pursue convenience-store trade shows as a deliberate channel OUTSIDE the COAM circuit, because they reach store owners rather than route operators; primary target the **GACS Southern Convenience Store & Petroleum Show**, with the Sept-17 C-Store Connect show as a borrowed-booth fallback. **§3 retitle — the show date is an OPEN CONTRADICTION:** the Aug-31 English source, read off the listing, says **October 22**; the Sept-7 Russian planning call says «октябрь 21» three times. Neither resolved; a multi-day show is flagged as inference only; aka C-store channel, GACS show (5 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-02-priorities-iq-ports-flex-pay-recycler-texas-on-wallets.md]] — (Sept-2 2026, active) priority order is **Flex-IQ → ports → Flex-Pay → immediately the Flex recycler**; **Texas is entered now, on wallets not TITO**; aka priorities Sept 2026 (2 sources, updated 2026-09-05)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-14-vertical-texas-starts-from-the-georgia-coam-vertical-games.md]] — the direct **horizontal→vertical conversion of the Texas games is dead on the art**, so a vertical Texas product starts from the **vertical Georgia COAM games** instead; three demoed experiments failed and a fourth was self-rejected (the stretch distorts scene and every symbol by ~57%; Dutch Mill and the other 3×3 games break at the monitor join; the rejected option distorts the top screen more than 2×; the vertical composition needs ~1253 px above two stacked 1080 areas, after an earlier ~1200 eyeball); **Pavel Frolov proposed it** — "может быть нам логичнее взять вертикальную игру для джорджии и её конвертировать в вертикальную игру для Техаса… будет гораздо дешевле" — **Val adopted it**, maths included ("мы всё будем адаптировать… мы просто возьмём игрушк[у], мы переделаем" / Pavel: "Математику другую"), Igor Metelski agreed; the progressive question is set aside rather than answered — every Georgia game's symbol-progressive **frames are baked into the background video**, solvable because the designers still hold the un-baked 3ds-Max scenes and can re-bake without those objects; **no date, cabinet or platform for a vertical Texas product is stated anywhere in the source**; open — who assembles the background video, which progressive a vertical Texas product carries, how big the maths rework is; status active (8 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-14-competitor-machine-access-at-diamond-goes-ahead-through-the-head-tech.md]] — with **Sean Fellows unreachable (at a golfing event)**, Val approves Diamond Amusement site visits arranged **by Diamond's head technician on her own initiative** — she "did not receive any instruction from Sean" and offered to set them up herself — for "at least three locations, one tier two"; the object is **access to competitors' machines and screenshots off them**, not Diamond's own; the Georgia **Class A errand is pulled forward from Wednesday to Tuesday** in case the machines are gone, with **Narasimha Rao Namburi ordered as a parallel Wednesday backup**; Sean's standing "confirm the location-tour day" commitment is marked **overtaken, not discharged** — the day was set by going round him; the head tech's name is rendered "Tara" and recorded as an **inference** toward Terra Horton, explicitly not asserted; open — are the Class A machines still at the Mexican restaurant, and is Sean told after the fact; status active (6 sources, updated 2026-09-19)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-15-unlimited-amusement-pilots-one-location.md]] — the operator takes **one pilot location and commits to no volume** (card provider left open — "Talk, and I will let you know. No pressure."), and Val accepts it rather than pushing, countering with a **new commercial instrument instead of a discount or an exclusivity ask**: schedule the whole rollout month by month in advance so JVL can reserve inventory, argued on **supply grounds** — "You will have difficulty securing inventory… Program the rollout to all of your locations on a monthly basis ahead of time so we can prepare inventory"; **no exclusivity was asked for at all**, which is worth noting against the ARC and Lucky Coin threads where it was; status active (2 sources, updated 2026-09-19)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-16-texas-front-operator-model-not-an-equal-partnership.md]] — Val's ruling on the shape of a Texas own-locations venture, and it opens a **fourth Texas thread — JVL being the location rather than selling into one**: a funded **front operator, explicitly not an equal partner and not fifty-fifty** ("I'm looking for somebody to be a front man to open up locations. I will not be splitting money with you fifty-fifty because it will be mainly my investment"), served by a purpose-built cheap **single-vertical-screen** machine ("Nothing fancy"), on an own-or-lease-locations model copied from a Colombian route that sold 50% to BlackRock in 2010 and retained the real estate; delivered alongside his full-disclosure self-description ("I am a wolf. I take no prisoners") and closed with a **deliberate non-decision** — "We're leaving this conversation open. I prefer no decision than a decision"; open — the actual split and capital figure, and whether the cheap vertical machine is the Sept-14 vertical-Texas build or a second product; status active (3 sources, updated 2026-09-20)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-05-18-stay-on-the-committed-transactional-pipeline.md]] — Val (May-18 2026): focus on FlexPay/POS/FlexPort/Recycler — no new-product detours; new ideas come in as risks (1 source, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-05-18-rename-flex-pos-away-from-point-of-sale.md]] — Val (May-18 2026): rename the Flex POS because operators hear "POS" as a store till — done as Flex-IQ by May 25 (2 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-17-the-ninety-dollar-fee-is-drafted-from-the-location-not-paid-by-the-master.md]] — Sept-17 2026 (Dynamic Gaming): the $90/month fee is drafted from each location by voided cheque, not paid by the master; no equipment contract; post-show price for everyone; service off if a location stops paying (3 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-09-22-unify-jvl-look-logo-and-slogan-untouched.md]] — Val (Sept-22 2026): unify JVL's look by collecting and arranging what exists — no rebrand; logo and slogan not touched ("my father's company") (3 sources, updated 2026-09-28)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-05-sergey-vysotskys-georgia-work-is-research-not-sales-in-short-spikes-reported-through-klimovich.md]] — Sergey Vysotsky does Georgia data research only, not sales, in short spikes reported through Klimovich (Oct 5 2026); aka spikes (5 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-05-jvl-does-not-reach-out-to-georgia-locations-and-aims-for-inbound-calls-to-its-ai-voice.md]] — JVL does no outreach to Georgia locations (Val cites federal restrictions); the goal is inbound calls answered by JVL's AI voice, plus an opt-in list (Oct 5 2026); aka reliable opt-in list, inbound AI voice (4 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-05-felipe-decides-by-october-11-one-18-game-peach-pack-or-three-separate-sticks.md]] — CLOSED as moot (owner 2026-10-15) — Felipe owned the choice, due Sunday Oct 11, of one 18-game Peach release or three USB sticks; lottery reports show one software number per pack (Oct 5 2026); aka 18 games in one pack (3 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-06-the-ten-arc-machines-are-released-this-week-with-modems.md]] — the ten ARC machines are released this week with modems; earlier machines upgraded to build 4333 (Oct 6 2026); aka release the 10 games for Arc (2 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-06-all-arc-machines-are-delivered-in-2026.md]] — all ARC machines ship in 2026, adding 16 cabinets to this year's build (Oct 6 2026); aka add 16 cabinets to this year (3 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-06-trial-customers-who-do-not-respond-are-invoiced-now.md]] — trial customers who do not respond (AKS, Epic) are invoiced now, not after Friday (Oct 6 2026); aka non-responding party (4 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-06-a-mini-distributor-tier-gets-about-8-percent-against-20-percent-for-a-full-distributor.md]] — a proposed mini-distributor tier (Oct 6 2026); the percentages (about 8% vs 20%) are placeholders for discussion, not decided (owner ruling Oct 18); aka mini distributor, Padma (5 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-06-every-machine-ships-with-a-modem-and-customers-are-told-reports-are-free-for-a-limited-time-with-an-opt-out.md]] — every machine ships with a modem; customers are told reports are free for a limited time and can opt out by message (Oct 6 2026; evolves the Aug-21 sign-to-activate rule); aka modem notice, we're evolving (5 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-13-incomm-and-jvl-reset-the-relationship-and-launch-on-prize-play-first.md]] — InComm and JVL park the past and launch on Prize Play first through normal certification; Skill Pay with ATM access waits for the lottery rule (Oct 13 2026); aka press a reset button, Prize Play first (2 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-13-ten-jvl-machines-go-into-intralots-lab-now-without-waiting-for-the-lottery.md]] — ten JVL machines fill Intralot's ten lab ports now, without waiting for the Lottery, and Intralot scans the whole field (Oct 13 2026); aka ten ports, scan the whole field (2 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-13-val-asks-the-lottery-in-one-letter-for-a-site-controller-or-testing-at-intralot.md]] — Val asks the Lottery in one letter for two options: a site controller in JVL's hands, or testing at Intralot (Oct 13 2026); aka two options on the table (2 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-13-arc-tests-the-jvl-transactional-set-at-one-non-kiosk-location.md]] — ARC tests six Flexports, one Flex IQ and a printer at one non-kiosk location after a demo; $90 per location per month monitoring fee (Oct 13 2026); aka Pax replacement test (2 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-13-arc-trades-in-old-machines-for-texas-as-credit-on-2027-purchases.md]] — handshake deal in principle: ARC's old machines go to Austin, Texas, paid as a one-year credit on 2027 purchases; quantity and price open (Oct 13 2026); aka ARC trade-in, Texas trade-in (4 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-13-arc-finishes-the-current-deal-first-and-buys-at-full-price-after-the-promotion.md]] — ARC takes no 65 machines before Christmas; the current deal comes first, full price after the promotion, about 8 machines a month in 2027 (Oct 13 2026; supersedes Oct 6 — owner-confirmed); aka no 65 before Christmas (3 sources, updated 2026-10-14)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-14-halcyons-november-test-is-one-tight-setup-with-pos-and-kiosk-at-forest-park-with-macon-as-fallback.md]] — one tightly scoped JVL test with POS and kiosk in November at a new Forest Park (GA) site waiting on its licences, Macon as fallback; likely the Sept-17 install now placed (inference); aka Forest Park pilot, Macon fallback (2 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-14-halcyon-texas-trial-two-jvl-machines-and-a-recycler-operator-fronts-the-cost-profit-split-50-50.md]] — agreed in principle: 2 JVL machines + 1 recycler in another operator's ~6-machine Texas location, Halcyon fronts ~$9,000, profit 50/50, Texas software, free conversion to Georgia COAM if it fails; D27 trade-ins go vertical by mid-to-end January; waits on Halcyon's partners; aka Texas profit share, my loss your gift (2 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-14-aks-tests-the-full-jvl-transactional-system-at-two-new-locations-before-year-end-and-jvl-installs-the-first.md]] — AKS wants the full JVL transactional package at two new locations, with 30+ days of data before year end; JVL sends its own people (Klimovich, Sebastian) to install the first; sites not yet named, AKS answer due Oct 15; aka AKS two-location test, we will install your first location (2 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-14-november-and-december-sales-go-to-trade-ins-a-6500-credit-for-jvl-machines-and-banilla-and-igt-machines-for-texas.md]] — Nov–Dec sales focus: $6,500 credit for old JVL machines against a new one; Banilla/IGT taken for Texas (~$1,500 + $2,500 kit); validators, printers and monitors crushed; aka marching orders, $6,500 trade-in (4 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-15-flex-iq-gets-a-switch-between-its-own-access-point-and-an-external-router-and-mvp2-starts-on-the-router.md]] — Flex IQ gets a switch, own access point or external router; MVP 2 starts on the router, and the router moves inside JVL hardware in MVP 3 or later; Bosik's one-week antenna spike; aka router or client mode (3 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-15-service-diagnostics-go-to-the-cloud-with-role-based-access-not-to-the-local-screen.md]] — Val: service and diagnostic data in MVP 2 go to the cloud, not the local screen, with role-based access (RBAC); Grafana stays staff-only; SSH access is an MVP 3 idea; aka diagnostics in the cloud, RBAC (2 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-15-installers-set-up-a-location-by-phone-with-a-qr-code-from-the-location-dashboard-the-location-map.md]] — Pavel's plan, approved by Val: Wi-Fi set on the location dashboard page, a QR generated there and scanned on each Flexport binds the ports to that Flex IQ; installers registered with JVL; aka location map (4 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-15-mvp2-is-flex-iq-wi-fi-remote-update-diagnostics-and-galaxy-reporting-and-flex-pay-moves-to-mvp3.md]] — Val's MVP 2: no Flex Pay (moved to MVP 3); Flex IQ, Wi-Fi, remote update incl. Flexports, diagnostics, Galaxy transactional reporting, location shortfall paid by card with the operator as guarantor; 2–3-week cycles; aka Flex Pay to MVP 3 (6 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-15-refurbished-trade-in-machines-are-sold-apart-from-the-show-special-and-show-special-machines-are-not-financed.md]] — Val to Blue Sky / Gold Rush: 20 refurbished trade-ins (90-day warranty, no topper, no modem) don't get the 50% show special; no financing on show-special machines; open contradiction with the Oct-14 AKS "no problem with twelve months"; aka no financing on discounted machines (3 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-16-the-flex-iq-commit-that-sets-the-modem-mac-at-boot-is-rolled-back-and-the-shared-mac-stays.md]] — Pavel rolls back the Flex IQ commit that set a MAC on the modem at boot (it breaks the modem link); one shared MAC on all modems is "the lesser evil"; a modem that returns only after a reboot must be fixed; aka modem MAC rollback, same MAC on all modems (2 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-16-puerto-rico-goes-through-one-distributor-at-twenty-percent-with-no-jvl-financing.md]] — Val's Puerto Rico terms: one reliable distributor, 20% commission on a ~$9,000 machine, no financing or collecting by JVL; transactional kit offered too; David doubts $9,000 works; aka Puerto Rico terms, nine thousand minus twenty percent (2 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-16-location-owner-calls-would-use-a-bought-voice-bot-service-not-one-jvl-builds.md]] — calls to Georgia location owners would use a bought voice-bot service, not a JVL-built bot; Sergey Vysotsky chooses and sets it up; a call center is an undecided plan B; aka bought voice bot, мы не будем строить свой бот (2 sources, updated 2026-10-17)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-20-machines-without-working-aft-connect-by-bill-validator-emulation-and-pulses-in-mvp1-and-the-port-mode-is-set-per-port.md]] — Val (Oct 20): machines without working AFT connect by bill-validator emulation (money in) and pulses (money out) in MVP 1; mode set per port, not detected; SAS 6.0+ data may become a paid product; release on a Wednesday, first install about Nov 2; reverses the Sept-7 SAS-only call; aka BV emulation mode (4 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-20-the-ris-improvements-release-notes-are-settled-point-by-point-and-the-tasks-are-to-be-rewritten-to-match-them.md]] — Val (Oct 20): the 9-point RIS improvements release notes settled (settings kept through an upgrade, lease period unaltered, peripherals register on their own, error screen names the cause, cash-out paragraph stays); Pavel and Irina rewrite tasks, capability and acceptance criteria to match; Intralot reset replies; aka RIS improvements release notes (5 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
- [[wiki/decisions/2026-10-20-diamond-gets-the-ris-improvements-first-on-p1-p2-and-p3-at-the-end-of-november-and-the-two-machine-trial-is-extended.md]] — Val to Diamond Amusement (Oct 20): RIS improvements first on P1–P3 at end of November (tentative), one-time decommission/recommission; JVL adds cell modems and pays the data; two-machine trial extended; 10–30% net-win uplift expected; aka tentative delivery end of November (3 sources, updated 2026-10-24)
